\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{കായികതാരം} (kāyikatāraṁ)}{കായികതാരം (kāyikatāraṁ)}]{\ml{കായികതാരം} (kāyikatāraṁ) — an athlete}

\label{lesson:ML-C568-kayikataram}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to overcome, then the Malayalam for to adapt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കായികതാരം}}
\textbf{\ml{കായികതാരം}} — \emph{kāyikatāraṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}an athlete\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{കായികതാരം} \ml{ഓട്ടത്തിൽ} \ml{സ്വർണ്ണം} \ml{നേടി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā kāyikatāraṁ ōṭṭattil svarṇṇaṁ nēṭi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
That athlete won gold in the race.
\end{quote}

\ml{കായികം} of the body, sport + \ml{താരം} a star.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{കായികതാരം}} (\emph{kāyikatāraṁ}) is a learned compound built from Sanskrit \emph{kāyika}, \textquotedblleft{}done with the body\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), and \ml{താരം}, from Sanskrit \emph{tārā}, \textquotedblleft{}a star\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5798).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāyikatāraṁ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kāyikatāraṁ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā kāyikatāraṁ ōṭṭattil svarṇṇaṁ nēṭi.} — That athlete won gold in the race.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to overcome, then the Malayalam for to adapt, then say \emph{kāyikatāraṁ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കായികതാരം} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An athlete\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പരിശീലകൻ} (pariśīlakan)}{പരിശീലകൻ (pariśīlakan)}]{\ml{പരിശീലകൻ} (pariśīlakan) — a coach; a trainer}

\label{lesson:ML-C568-parisilakan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to adapt, then the Malayalam for an athlete.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പരിശീലകൻ}}
\textbf{\ml{പരിശീലകൻ}} — \emph{pariśīlakan} — \textquotedblleft{}a coach; a trainer\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{പരിശീലകൻ} \ml{ടീമിനെ} \ml{രാവിലെ} \ml{ആറ്} \ml{മണിക്ക്} \ml{വിളിച്ചു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pariśīlakan ṭīmine rāvile āṟŭ maṇikkŭ viḷiccu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The coach called the team at six in the morning.
\end{quote}

From \ml{പരിശീലനം}, training, already familiar.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പരിശീലകൻ}} (\emph{pariśīlakan}) is built on \ml{പരിശീലനം}, from Sanskrit \emph{pariśīlana}, \textquotedblleft{}contact, constant occupation, study\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), with the agent ending -\ml{അകൻ}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pariśīlakan}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pariśīlakan}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pariśīlakan ṭīmine rāvile āṟŭ maṇikkŭ viḷiccu.} — The coach called the team at six in the morning.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to adapt, then the Malayalam for an athlete, then say \emph{pariśīlakan} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പരിശീലകൻ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A coach; a trainer\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഗോൾ} (gōḷ)}{ഗോൾ (gōḷ)}]{\ml{ഗോൾ} (gōḷ) — a goal (in a match)}

\label{lesson:ML-C568-gol}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for an athlete, then the Malayalam for a coach.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഗോൾ}}
\textbf{\ml{ഗോൾ}} — \emph{gōḷ} — \textquotedblleft{}a goal (in a match)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{അവസാന} \ml{മിനിറ്റിൽ} \ml{അവൻ} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{ഗോൾ} \ml{അടിച്ചു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{avasāna miniṟṟil avan oru gōḷ aṭiccu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He scored a goal in the last minute.
\end{quote}

\ml{ഗോൾ} \ml{അടിക്കുക} is to score a goal.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഗോൾ}} (\emph{gōḷ}) was borrowed from English \emph{goal}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gōḷ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gōḷ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avasāna miniṟṟil avan oru gōḷ aṭiccu.} — He scored a goal in the last minute.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for an athlete, then the Malayalam for a coach, then say \emph{gōḷ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ഗോൾ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A goal (in a match)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{റഫറി} (ṟaphaṟi)}{റഫറി (ṟaphaṟi)}]{\ml{റഫറി} (ṟaphaṟi) — a referee}

\label{lesson:ML-C568-raphari}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a coach, then the Malayalam for a goal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{റഫറി}}
\textbf{\ml{റഫറി}} — \emph{ṟaphaṟi} — \textquotedblleft{}a referee\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{റഫറി} \ml{കളി} \ml{പത്ത്} \ml{മിനിറ്റ്} \ml{നിർത്തി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ṟaphaṟi kaḷi pattŭ miniṟṟŭ nirtti.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The referee stopped the game for ten minutes.
\end{quote}

Malayalam writes the English f with \ml{ഫ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{റഫറി}} (\emph{ṟaphaṟi}) was borrowed from English \emph{referee}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṟaphaṟi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṟaphaṟi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṟaphaṟi kaḷi pattŭ miniṟṟŭ nirtti.} — The referee stopped the game for ten minutes.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a coach, then the Malayalam for a goal, then say \emph{ṟaphaṟi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{റഫറി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A referee\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{മത്സരിക്കുക} (matsarikkuka)}{മത്സരിക്കുക (matsarikkuka)}]{\ml{മത്സരിക്കുക} (matsarikkuka) — to compete}

\label{lesson:ML-C568-matsarikkuka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a goal, then the Malayalam for a referee.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മത്സരിക്കുക}}
\textbf{\ml{മത്സരിക്കുക}} — \emph{matsarikkuka} — \textquotedblleft{}to compete\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ഇരുപത്} \ml{ടീമുകൾ} \ml{കപ്പിനായി} \ml{മത്സരിച്ചു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{irupatŭ ṭīmukaḷ kappināyi matsariccu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Twenty teams competed for the cup.
\end{quote}

Past: \ml{മത്സരിച്ചു}, \emph{matsariccu}.

The noun \ml{മത്സരം}, a competition, is already familiar; the rival takes -\ml{ഓട്}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{മത്സരിക്കുക}} (\emph{matsarikkuka}) is built from \ml{മത്സരം}, from Sanskrit \emph{matsara}, \textquotedblleft{}exhilarating; jealous\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 9756), with the Malayalam verb ending -\ml{ിക്കുക}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{matsarikkuka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{matsarikkuka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{irupatŭ ṭīmukaḷ kappināyi matsariccu.} — Twenty teams competed for the cup.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a goal, then the Malayalam for a referee, then say \emph{matsarikkuka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{മത്സരിക്കുക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To compete\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
